## Gallery

### Calendar

Geom point but make squares. Source code [here](https://www.miriam-lerma.com/blog/2024-01-15-calendar/calendar).

```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.align='left',  out.width="50%"}
# 2024-01
knitr::include_graphics("https://github.com/MiriamLL/data_supporting_webpage/blob/main/Blog/2024/calendar_export.jpg?raw=true")
```
